caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a woman with fair skin and long, curly, light brown hair that is parted in the middle and falls over her shoulders. She is dressed in an off-the-shoulder black bodice with a gold-colored brooch at the center of the neckline and is wearing a teal blue dress with folds and creases depicted in the fabric. The lower portion of the figure transitions into a scroll-shaped wooden base, partially visible at the lower left corner, which is colored black with ornate golden yellow detailing. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or elements present aside from the central female bust and base.
title: Figurehead: "Jenny Lind"
